summary: Practise response coordination, partner oversight and monitoring with humanitarian case exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Humanitarian aid training helps programme managers, response coordinators and partnership officers turn response priorities into coordinated, trackable delivery. Participants develop response logic, map partner coverage with 4Ws data, and use monitoring to spot delivery gaps and adapt activities. They also practise checking service continuity against Sphere standards and managing partner commitments and feedback follow-up.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate humanitarian response implementation, manage partner commitments or report on delivery and adaptation. It suits people who need to turn response priorities into trackable work across teams.
modules: Theory of Change and Response Logic
prerequisites: Working familiarity with humanitarian response or programme implementation; no coding is required.
